comparison_rule: Descending length of declared OSW reference routes only. Studied reaches are excluded from the reference-route order. No number replaces the existing length evidence or published ranking.

planning_taxonomy.author: OSW
planning_taxonomy.scope: Primary construction strategy for each of the 89 inventory names without a published ranked length. Categories are work priorities, can have overlapping physical constraints, and do not establish current boundaries or comparable lengths.

strategies.label: Split basin families
strategies.description: Shared labels need basin-specific child objects before any route length. Existing children are navigation links, not a complete family census.
strategies.next_action: Measure sourced basin members separately; create any missing child identities before route construction.

strategies.label: Define system and branch graph
strategies.description: A main route, component reaches and alternate branches need separate length semantics.
strategies.next_action: Specify the source-defined system, branch connectivity, depth and non-overlapping component gates; retain study reaches separately.

strategies.label: Keep continuity hypothesis separate
strategies.description: A proposed connection cannot be ranked as an established current merely because a path can be drawn.
strategies.next_action: Audit continuity evidence and alternatives; retain hypothetical status and any proposed distance separately.

strategies.label: Construct seasonal routes
strategies.description: A specified seasonal regime is needed; reversal or seasonal extensions cannot become a permanent route.
strategies.next_action: Choose sourced season, direction and layer; construct each supported seasonal path separately and preserve missing seasons.

strategies.label: Construct dated or regime-specific geometry
strategies.description: Variable loops, circuits and frontal paths need a specified date or regime and continuity test.
strategies.next_action: Use dated or explicitly averaged geometry, distinguish an open loop from a closed circuit, and compare repeated regimes before summarizing.

strategies.label: Resolve naming or extent convention
strategies.description: Aliases, source-dependent limits or proposed continuity need an explicit identity/extent decision. A regional candidate may use a declared convention meanwhile.
strategies.next_action: Read competing definitions, resolve aliases versus distinct flows, and retain source-convention routes without merging their extents.

strategies.label: Construct layer-specific paths
strategies.description: Subsurface jets, undercurrents and overflows require depth, density or tracer support along the route.
strategies.next_action: Specify source layer and time support, obtain intermediate pathway geometry, and separate branches or dilution thresholds before measuring.

strategies.label: Extend evidence beyond sections
strategies.description: Cross-stream sections locate a current locally but do not define an along-stream route.
strategies.next_action: Find sourced upstream/downstream gates and continuity between sections; preserve widths and section transports as different measurements.

strategies.label: Preserve surveyed-reach scope
strategies.description: A documented regional survey reach remains a reach until whole-flow gates are supported.
strategies.next_action: Reconstruct only the source survey reach first; obtain independent start/end evidence before proposing a broader current route.

strategies.label: Establish a sourced regional route
strategies.description: Regional named flow or branch eligible for a declared reference convention once gates and route geography are supported. This does not assert that the flow is unbranched or steady.
strategies.next_action: Read primary geographic definitions, choose explicit endpoint/branch/layer/time conventions, and measure a reviewed route with alternatives; naming points alone are insufficient.
